name: invompt
description: Create and review invoice drafts from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: Create and review invoice drafts from your AI assistant. Start without creating an account. Create one later and keep all your invoices. Use the same workflow for quotes and estimates; a pro forma is represented as a quote. Reuse saved clients and settings, inspect hosted review links, revise the selected document, or download an existing invoice as a PDF. Email delivery requires a signed-in account and recipient confirmation. You control every document change; Invompt does not process payments.
defaultPrompt: Create a quote from this conversation. Ask for any missing billing details before saving it.
Give me the hosted invoice link so I can open it and download the PDF.
When I am signed in, email the selected document after I confirm the recipient.
